📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Joyce just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Emma just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Nikos, Rosa and Tashi met them at the door — 3 put down. Rosa, Tashi are hurt.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
🛡️ Maya, Vasyl, Noelia and Mia met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 barely walked away. Noelia didn't come back. Maya, Vasyl, Mia are hurt.

opens.openerLine: "Pantry's thin and getting thinner. Come forage with me tomorrow — two of us can fill packs."
"About the pantry run — I hate to ask twice, but it's still open. Will you?"
"What's the most useful thing you've learned since we got here?"
"Please — tell me you've got food to spare. I'm going hungry here. I can't keep going like this."
"The food I needed — I haven't stopped thinking about it."
"About the most useful thing you've learned — What's the most useful thing you've learned since we got here?"
"Hey." Joyce settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to."
"Now then — ...Hi. Sorry. I'm not good at the talking-to-strangers part."
"About the pantry run — the need hasn't gone anywhere. I'm still asking."
"Never mind the food I needed — we got it handled. Thanks anyway."
"Can we talk?" Nikos sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"I'm going hungry — do you have anything to eat? Anything at all? My hands shake when I try to work."
"Can we talk?" Theo sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"Mind if I just sit with you for a bit?"
"Can I tell you something? I can't read, and I'm scared it matters now."
"Listen. I need you to hear this before you go back out there."
Tashi: "Hey — come here. You should hear this."
"Pantry's thin and getting thinner. Will you forage with me tomorrow? Two pairs of eyes, twice the ground."
"I've been turning something over. What do YOU think actually happened to us?"
"About that warning — I keep turning it over."
"What's something you're good at that nobody here knows about?"
"About what you're good at — What's something you're good at that nobody here knows about?"
"About what you think happened to us — I've been turning something over. What do YOU think actually happened to us?"
"The birds went quiet an hour ago. They haven't started again. Noting it."
"Hey. Got a minute? No reason. Just — hey."
"Yeah — Listen. I need you to hear this before you go back out there."
"We're eating through stores faster than we replace them. Forage with me tomorrow? I know the ridge above the creek."
I'm not dying for anyone's principles. I do what keeps me breathing. Remember that.
Tashi: "I've heard good things about Thornfield. We should link with them — we'd be stronger together."
"Every laugh out there feels wrong today. Then I feel wrong for thinking it."
"I keep expecting to see them by the fire. Then I remember."
"Pantry's thin and getting thinner. Forage with me tomorrow? I know the far treeline, past the rocks."
"Where are you from — originally? Before all this."
"About the pantry run — still need hands. Are you in?"
"What's something from your old life that's actually useful here?"
"About just sitting with someone — I keep turning it over."
"Do you still count the days? I lost track days ago."
"This cut — I can't clean it properly one-handed. Could you take a look?"
"Never mind the pantry run — we got it handled. Thanks anyway."
"What's the kindest thing someone's done for you out here?"
"Never mind this wound — we got it handled. Thanks anyway."
"I asked Lamar about the kindest thing someone's done for you — Lamar's gone. What's the kindest thing someone's done for you out here?"
"About the kindest thing someone's done for you — What's the kindest thing someone's done for you out here?"
"You look handy. What did you do with your hands, before?"
"About what you did with your hands — You look handy. What did you do with your hands, before?"
"What do you make of all this? Really."
"Do you ever just need to be alone? Like, really alone?"
"About needing to be alone — Do you ever just need to be alone? Like, really alone?"
"Don't mind me. Today's just heavy. Let's move."
"Never mind the pantry run — we got it handled. Thanks anyway. Stay near tonight? Please. I don't want to be alone when it gets dark."
"I don't know what to do with my hands today."
Nikos: "Hey. I want to ask it plain: will you be my bonded friend? I'll watch your back if you watch mine."
"We gave them a good burial. Doesn't feel like enough, does it?"
"What are you hoping for? Not the big stuff. The small thing."
"About what you're hoping for — What are you hoping for? Not the big stuff. The small thing."
"Listen. I need you to hear this before you go back out there."
"Do you still sing? ...Sorry — weird question. I just realized I haven't heard anyone sing."
"It's quiet today. Wrong kind of quiet. Moving on."
"Can we talk?" Mara sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"I asked Tashi about what you're hoping for — Tashi's gone. What are you hoping for? Not the big stuff. The small thing."
"Mind if I just sit with you for a bit?"
Mara: "I've heard good things about Thornfield. We should link with them — we'd be stronger together."
"What got you through the first week? The very first days."
"I don't mind you. Don't make a big deal out of it."
"I asked Mia about what got you through the first week — Mia's gone. What got you through the first week? The very first days."
"I hate to ask, but tell me you've got food to spare. I'm past hungry here. My hands shake when I try to work."
"Can we talk?" Elias sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."

lines.line: (Talking costs a little energy — 10 kcal a conversation. Small talk is cheap; going deep costs time, not more food.)
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
